content.short: Sonne Finance is a decentralized, non-custodial liquidity market protocol on Optimism Mainnet.
content.description: Sonne Finance is a decentralized lending protocol that provides financial services to individuals, institutions, and other protocols. It is permissionless, open-source, and built as an Optimistic protocol for the Optimism ecosystem. Users can deposit assets, put them to work as collateral, and borrow against them, enabling flexible liquidity and on-chain leverage. The design emphasizes transparent access and permissionless participation on the Optimism network.
